summary: WW-C (Engines) is wired behind its flags, and with every flag off the ladder behaves exactly as the audited build. A recorded 40-tick set gives the same intents and records as the pre-edit ladder.py: 111 intents and 8 records, with identical sha256 digests. Ladder changes: `LadderEngine(params, versions, flags=())`. With `touch` on, touch-up/touch-down markets are priced by growth.touch.touch_fair through `touch_value()`. It refuses NaN or non-positive price, vol, running high/low, strike or basis, and refuses tau <= 0 (the Phase 3 audit's NaN gave f = 1.0). It also converts kappa keys that come back as strings after a JSON round-trip, adds the ladder's `vol` key, and tags touch intents with versions ("touch", 1). A log-only touch<terminal coherence check runs through `touch_flags()`; it is guarded against tau <= 0 and sigma <= 0, and it keeps the upper flag only when the digital settles at the window end. With `quote_objective` on, quotes = `wider(quote_objective.optimise(...), quotes(...))`, so the Phase 1 quotes are the anchor and the objective can never quote higher, larger, or a token Phase 1 skips. `engine.oracle_gap` (a set of cids) adds the pull reason "oracle_gap". `NegRiskScanner` turns crawler rows into negRisk events and returns only ("negrisk_scan", row, ms) records. Its rows are ineligible without both a signed confirmation and the secret. New trader/engines/sports_maker.py: `SportsMakerEngine` ("sports-maker") runs fair.fair, continuous_sources, quote_allowed and pulls.pull_reasons. If there is any pull reason, it returns no quotes. Otherwise it uses Phase 1's shrink, invariant_ok and quotes(), with expiry capped at pulls.maker_expiry. Without the SGO key there is no sharp snapshot, so it fails closed. New trader/engines/fast_maker.py: `FastMakerEngine(ledger)` wraps FastUpDownMaker. It re-reads e6_edges every 60 s and returns [] while the gate is closed: no ledger, no pre-registration, no result row, a failing row, or an unreadable ledger.

The gate is re-read after refresh_ms and closes again.

key_results:
- Flags off: the ladder's output is byte-identical to the audited build (C1 digest test), and the full suite passes: 711.
- Performance: the Phase 5 optimiser with 1-share size steps takes about 0.25 to 0.65 s per market, which is too slow for the 1 s ladder loop. objective_quotes therefore passes size_step = quote_size, which brings it to about 6 ms per market. wider() caps the size at the Phase 1 size anyway.
- The touch audit defects are guarded in the ladder: NaN inputs used to give f = 1.0, coherence_flags crashed at tau <= 0 or sigma = 0, and kappa keys came back as strings after JSON.
- Keyed sports odds missing means no quotes (fail closed). The fast maker stays silent until a passing E6 row exists.
- No runs were needed for these ACs; they are all unit tests on tmp_path ledgers. I created no data/trader/wiring_* folder. Nothing under data/trader/paper14/ was read or written: no command referenced data/, and every ledger used was a pytest tmp_path. I signalled no process. My one backgrounded pytest exited on its own (exit code 0).

How to reproduce (from the roster folder):
  .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/wiring/test_ww_c.py trader/tests tests/invariants -q
  .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest trader/tests tests/invariants tests/phase2 tests/phase3 tests/phase4 tests/phase5 tests/wiring -q
flag_notes:
The engines read flag names only; trader/features.py (WW-D) turns them on.
- touch: `LadderEngine(flags={"touch", ...})` lets touch-up/touch-down crypto-term markets into the ladder. They are priced by touch_value, which applies the guards. Quotes still require tau <= max_tau_h (24 h), and intents carry ("touch", 1). Coherence findings go to records as arb_opportunity (log only). Marketdata (WW-B) must provide ref[asset]["high"/"low"]; without them touch_value returns err.
- quote_objective: `LadderEngine(flags={"quote_objective"})` makes market_intents use wider(optimise(...), quotes(...)). The optimiser uses fit = quote_objective.PRIOR, horizon tau = min(QO_PARAMS["requote_s"] = 60 s, time to the pull before close), and sigma = fv["vol"]/sqrt(60), a model-implied proxy. The reward pool is used only if engine.rewards[cid] has positive min_size, max_spread and daily_rate.
- settlement → `engine.oracle_gap = keeper.oracle_gap()` (a set of cids); pull_reason returns "oracle_gap". It is empty by default.
- negrisk_scan: `sc = ladder.NegRiskScanner(); sc.on_snapshot(crawler_rows); for t, row, ms in sc.scan(books, now, rtt_ms, feed_fresh, confirmations, secret): ledger.record(t, row, ms)`. It never returns intents. Without a secret or a matching signed confirmation, every row is ineligible.
- sports: `SportsMakerEngine()`. The loop sets .maps {cid: MarketMap}, .sharp, .continuous, .methods, .game_states {event_key: GameState}, .lineups, .cautions, .feed_age_ms, calls on_fill, and drains .records (always empty today). .last_pulls holds the reasons per cid. The strategy name is "sports-maker".
- fast_maker: `FastMakerEngine(ledger)`. It is gated by fast_updown.e6_edges(ledger, now), re-read every 60 s, and returns [] while that is closed. The strategy name is "fast-updown-maker".
With no flags, `LadderEngine()` is the audited Phase 1 engine, and the two new engines are never built.
open_issues: NegRiskScanner lives in trader/engines/ladder.py, next to the role-18 arb scans, because no file was assigned to it in my ownership list. WW-D imports it from there.

Name mismatch for WW-A/WW-D: the engine strategy is "sports-maker" (as in the dispatch), but sports.fair.SOCCER_PREREG says strategy "soccer-maker". Kernel STRATEGIES needs a "sports-maker" entry, and the registry/prereg naming should be aligned when the loop writes them.

The quote objective's sigma is a model-implied proxy (fv vol per sqrt(s)), not realised mid volatility, and it uses the synthetic PRIOR fill/adverse fit. The size grid is coarsened to quote_size for speed. These are marked as ponytail/inline notes; the gate remains Loop B plus the human token before any promotion.

Touch markets quote only when tau <= 24 h (max_tau_h; kappa is unfitted beyond that), so monthly and year-end touch windows can only quote in their last day. Before that, they appear only in checkpoints and coherence logs.
oracle_gap is mostly belt-and-braces today: the ladder already skips markets at or after end_ms, and the keeper only flags printed markets.
FastMakerEngine starts its inner price history only once the gate opens, so the first window after opening has no recorded open and will not quote until the next window. This fails closed.
SportsMakerEngine.records is always empty (it logs nothing), and the sports registry/prereg writes (sports-devig, sports-sigma, SOCCER_PREREG) are left to WW-D.
